steps.en: The check results (payment and PLUS appeal) are shown on screen
steps.id: Hasil cek (pembayaran dan appeal PLUS) tampil di layar
steps.why_en: The screen shows no PLUS appeal result.
steps.why_id: Layar tidak menampilkan hasil appeal PLUS.

steps.en: The screen shows appeal data from PLUS (date, status, reply date)
steps.id: Layar menampilkan data appeal dari PLUS (tanggal, status, tanggal reply)
steps.why_en: No appeal data exists to show.
steps.why_id: Data appeal tidak ada untuk ditampilkan.

steps.en: The officer downloads a copy of the results as a file
steps.id: Officer download salinan hasil dalam bentuk file
steps.why_en: The download works but misses appeal data and shows partly paid as fully paid.
steps.why_id: Download jalan tapi tanpa data appeal dan bayar sebagian tertulis lunas.
